exposure: mode of delivery (vaginal vs. emergency caesarean section vs. elective caesarean section)
cohort: 100 cases of singleton fetuses in breech presentation admitted to the labor room.
finding: Planned vaginal delivery for breech presentation is feasible in carefully selected preterm and term patients, given proper counseling, strict intrapartum monitoring, and an experienced obstetrician.
mod_finding: Babies delivered by elective caesarean section had higher 5-minute APGAR scores (100% >7) and higher average birth weights (2.9 kg) compared to those delivered by emergency caesarean (87% >7 APGAR, 2.5 kg) or vaginally (65% >7 APGAR, 1.8 kg).
birth_weight: Average birth weights varied by mode of delivery: 1.8 kg (vaginal), 2.5 kg (emergency caesarean), and 2.9 kg (elective caesarean).
